title: The Most Reproduced Image
summary: A gallery of identical broken images whose placeholder glyph is drawn by the browser vendor, not the artist.
mechanism: Intentionally invalid inline data-URI sources fail locally so each browser engine substitutes its own broken-image placeholder; a Reproduce button clones editions in RAM only, zero network.
references: Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
Olia Lialina & Dragan Espenschied, One Terabyte of Kilobyte Age (net.art broken-image tradition)
